components_instructions.general: Do not use standard Shadcn subtle shadows. Override all card and button styles with the Neo-Brutalist borders (border-[3px] border-[#121212]) and hard shadows.
components_instructions.buttons: Must have thick borders, bold text, and hard offset shadows. On click, the button should translate down and right to meet the shadow.
components_instructions.game_mode_cards: Use different pastel background colors for each game mode card. Example: Flash Cards = primary (#FFB8D1), Speed Reading = secondary (#A8E6CF), Memory Match = accent (#FFD3B6).
components_instructions.navigation: Sticky top nav with a solid border-b-[3px] border-[#121212]. Background should be solid white (#FFFFFF).
components_instructions.icons: Use lucide-react with strokeWidth={2.5} to match the bold, chunky aesthetic.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text-to-background contrast is high. The deep charcoal text (#121212) on pastel backgrounds exceeds WCAG AAA standards.
accessibility.data_testid: MANDATORY on all interactive and key informational elements (e.g. data-testid='mode-flash-cards-btn').

motion_and_interactions.hover_state: Translate elements slightly along X and Y axes, reducing the hard shadow size to simulate pressing.
motion_and_interactions.game_feedback: Use pop and bounce keyframes for correct/incorrect answers to create a playful feel.

image_urls.description: Colorful geometric shapes for abstract dashboard backgrounds or empty states.
Soft pastel background for the main splash screen or settings page.
Vibrant puzzle pieces for Memory Matching mode.

instructions_to_main_agent: You are building a game app for speed reading and memory.
Implement the UI using a Neo-Brutalist design language: thick black borders (border-[3px]), hard black drop shadows (shadow-[4px_4px_0px_#121212]), and soft pastel backgrounds.
Avoid subtle gradients or soft blurs. Everything should feel tactile, bold, and playful.
Use Outfit for headings and DM Sans for body text.
For the Game Modes, create large clickable cards with distinct pastel backgrounds.
Remember to include data-testid attributes on all interactive elements.
